title: What Is Plot? Plot Definition
use_cases: Use when crafting a narrative arc to guide a story from introduction to resolution
Implement when defining character growth through escalating challenges
Configure when mapping out plot beats for screenplay or novel outline
Use when analyzing a story’s structure to identify key turning points
Apply when designing interactive fiction to ensure player decisions lead to a climax
content: Plot is a sequence of events in a story in which the main character is put into a challenging situation that forces them to make increasingly difficult choices, driving the story toward a climactic event and resolution.
